route.rationale: one function; Windows short-name paths; CI red from lcwr-1

cells.title: Match an absolute leader-check artifact through an aliased worktree path
cells.action: In record_leader_check's relative_artifact closure, when the raw strip_prefix of the worktree root fails, canonicalize both the root and the artifact and strip again; fall back to the raw artifact. Red first on Linux with a unix-only test that reaches the worktree through a symlinked alias of the temp dir (the same shape as a Windows 8.3 short name versus the long name git reports).

truths: An absolute artifact reached through an alias of the worktree root overlaps its relative files_changed entry
The existing leader_check tests stay green

artifacts.substantive: relative_artifact canonicalizes on a failed strip

key_links: relative_artifact feeds the files_changed overlap check
prohibitions: No change to refusal message text
